evidence_spans: Calculations were performed at the LDA-relaxed lattice parametera= 5.58Å, about1.4%below the experimental value of5.658Å quoted in Ref. 7, consistent with the well-known tendency of the LDA to overbind and hence underestimate equilibrium lattice constants.

Calculations were performed at the LDA-relaxed lattice parametera= 5.58Å, about1.4%below the experimental value of5.658Å quoted in Ref. 7, consistent with the well-known tendency of the LDA to overbind and hence underestimate equilibrium lattice constants.
CLM-MAT-0134.statement: The calculated LDA-relaxed lattice parameter for germanium is 5.58 Å.

extra_quotes: We implement the resulting equations using Wannier interpolation in theEPIq code and apply them to photoexcited germanium.
